item.title: Buzz of the Week: Who do you trust more to draw Utah’s voting maps?
item.description: After years of lawsuits, the courts have ordered a new map for 2026 that gives Democrats a fighting chance in a new Salt Lake County-based district.

item.title: Gordon Monson: U.S. Olympians who disapprove of what is happening in America should be respected, not criticized
item.description: As some members of Team USA voice their opinions on political and social issues, they face backlash on social media.

item.title: Bagley Cartoon: Race to the Bottom
item.description: Check out Pat Bagley's latest cartoon: Race to the Bottom

item.title: Utah’s massive data centers can’t get the power they need, so they’re building their own
item.description: Utah’s headlong rush to build data centers to power the AI boom is likely to rely upon fossil fuels for the foreseeable future, raising concerns about the state’s already struggling air quality.

item.title: The Big 12 Conference stepped in to stop the anti-LDS chants at BYU games. This is what it did to punish Oklahoma State.
item.description: The Big 12 Conference stepped in to stop the anti-LDS chants at BYU games. This is what it did to punish Oklahoma State.

item.title: Driver jailed after 3 disabled Utah men were found dead of suspected carbon monoxide poisoning
item.description: The driver works for a business that transports people with disabilities, police said.

item.title: Faster, cheaper, better: How factory-built homes could help Utah’s housing crisis
item.description: These new homes, built like Legos for grownups, could be a solution to address Utah's housing crisis?

item.title: Utah college students could turn down assignments based on ‘religious and conscience beliefs’ under this bill
item.description: Several Utah faculty members spoke out against HB204, arguing a university education is meant to challenge students and expose them to different ideas.

item.title: Why Lindsey Vonn calls this U.S. women’s ski team the best she’s ever seen. Hint: Utahns play a big part.
item.description: Based on top-10 World Cup finishes, this is by far the best World Cup women's Alpine ski team in the history of the United States. Utah athletes, from 41-year-old Lindsey Vonn to 22-year-old Mary Bocock, are key to that success.

item.title: With their lawsuit awaiting appeal, 3 former Team USA athletes file another suit against U.S. Ski & Snowboard and their former coach
item.description: Three former Team USA snowboarders filed a lawsuit in Utah court against former Olympics coach Peter Foley and U.S. Ski & Snowboard almost exactly four years after allegations of sexual abuse by Foley became public during the 2022 Beijing Winter Games.
